title: Aspyn Ovard Reveals How She Got Throuple Partner to Join Mormon Wives: OC
summary: Secret Lives of Mormon Wives: Orange County star Aspyn Ovard revealed how she convinced her partners to film with her her on the Hulu series.
body_markdown:
Aspyn Ovard’s relationship with Briana and Billy Davis won’t be off-limits on[The Secret Lives of Mormon Wives: Orange County](https://www.siriusxm.com/blog/tag/the-secret-lives-of-mormon-wives) — but convincing Briana to appear on the reality show wasn’t easy.


[The Secret Lives of Mormon Wives: OC Exclusive Cast Event Listen on the App Listen on the App](https://sxm.app.link/BlogMWOCCastEventRadioAndy)


During *The* *Secret Lives of Mormon Wives: OC Cast Event* at SiriusXM’s Los Angeles studios, Aspyn revealed to[the Smith Sisters](https://www.siriusxm.com/blog/tag/smith-sisters-live) on[Radio Andy (Ch. 101)](https://www.siriusxm.com/blog/tag/radio-andy) that her partner initially resisted stepping into the spotlight.


“It’s just very helpful for me to have her be able to be at home with me and supporting me through that. And so her being able to be on social media..one I think she’s just so fun,” Aspyn—who confirmed her relationship with Bri and Billy—in March said. “I was like, ‘The world needs to see you.’ She’s so good at yapping, we literally will sit and yap in like a 10 minute unedited TikTok.”


“But I did have to beg her,” she added. “We had a lot of conversations. She didn’t really want anything to do with like social media she’s been very private. And so it took a long time, but I was like ‘Come on, it’s a once in a lifetime opportunity.’ To be doing all of this is something that they never would want to hold me back from.”


- **Related:[Jessi Draper Opens Up About Her Divorce and More](https://www.siriusxm.com/blog/jessi-draper-call-her-daddy)**


Aspyn, who split from her husband and the father of her three children Parker Ferris in 2024, has no problem sharing the new spotlight with Bri.


“I think that after some time and talking about it a lot, I was like, ‘I know you can do it,’ she said. “And she’s doing great. She’s the best, I’m her number one fan.”


Bri has fans in the cast. So much so, they have dubbed her the seventh Mormon wife.


“We also really want her to come,” Bobbi shared. “I’m like. ‘Hey where’s Bri?’ Even here I was like, ‘Is Bri doing press with us?'”


Stream the full premiere season of *Secret Lives of Mormon Wives: Orange County* on Hulu starting November 12.
